_help.note: JSON has no comments; this _help block is documentation only and is ignored by the generator.
_help.distribution: Sets the distribution for numeric columns. Use top-level 'distribution' for the global default, or add a 'distribution' key inside any ranges entry to override it per column.

available_distributions.normal: Gaussian centred on the range midpoint (std = range/6).
available_distributions.poisson: Discrete counts, anchored at min (lam = range/2).
available_distributions.binomial: Discrete, anchored at min (n = round(range), p = 0.5).
available_distributions.random: Uniform within range (the 'absolute random' mode; alias of uniform).

_help.optional_params: Each ranges entry may also include a 'params' object to tune a distribution, e.g. normal: {mean, std}; exponential: {scale}; poisson: {lam}; binomial: {n, p}.
